summary: Residential kerb where cars park, beside a vacant lot; apartments across the road.

best_section.where: Ada Street, outside the vacant grassed lot on the south side

drivers.seclusion: Vacant lot behind the kerb, but apartments 13-23 m across the road and homes either side.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide sealed street with a parked-car lane; room to stop at the kerb.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street; busier main road at the east end.
drivers.convention: Many cars park along both kerbs, so a van would blend in.

flags: Steep: about 9-10% grade here, 6.5% mean overall
No Stopping Any Time signs at the east end (0-15 m)
sun_shade: Mostly open on the south side; trees shade the north side and the afternoon sun comes over the lot.
rubbish: Some building debris on the lot next door; none else seen.
